newsitem.title: BELARUS: Accident shuts Russia-Poland pipeline in Belarus.
newsitem.headline: Accident shuts Russia-Poland pipeline in Belarus.

text.p: A fire on the Belarus section of a gas pipeline carrying gas from Russia to Poland has shut the pipeline on Wednesday, an emergencies ministry official said.

Daniil Korolkov, first deputy head of Promatomnadzor, which oversees industrial safety at the ministry, said the accident happened after 3 p.m. (1200 GMT) in a field about 60 km (40 miles) south of the capital Minsk.
"Representatives of Beltransgaz have gone to the site," Korolkov said, referring to Russian monopoly Gazprom's Belarussian transit partner.
The duty officer at Beltransgaz said rescue workers were working on reducing the fire, which Interfax-West news agency said had spread to a nearby wood.
There were no reports of any injuries as a result of the accident, Korolkov said, adding no more details were available.
